A Sultanpur court in Uttar Pradesh has acquitted Lok Sabha Leader of Opposition Rahul Gandhi in a 2018 criminal defamation case over his remarks against then BJP president Amit Shah. Advocate Kashi Prasad Shukla confirmed the verdict, while Congress MP Pawan Khera welcomed the court’s decision.
